visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor sunroom with white-framed glass walls and many potted green plants, a man in a black T-shirt and blue jeans is seated on a minimalist white metal chair. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark brown oversized blazer and black trousers, walks toward him from the right. The lighting is natural and bright. (2) The scene transitions to the entrance of a modern apartment. The man enters carrying a silver TOM FORD gift bag and a bouquet of bright red roses. The woman, now in a black tank top, welcomes him excitedly while a small, cream-colored dog jumps up at the door. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hands as she pulls a sleek black lipstick case out of a silver textured paper bag featuring the TOM FORD logo. The background is a dimly lit, soft-focus interior. (4) Multiple quick-cut sequences show the woman applying five different shades of lipstick. Each sub-phase features a close-up of her lips, a swatch of the color on the back of her hand, and the lipstick tube itself. The shades range from soft peach to deep berry pink. (5) In the final scene, five black lipstick tubes are arranged in a row on a white surface, with a black compact case held behind them by the woman who is now blurred in the background. Large white text overlays appear at the bottom providing specific promotional details.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> List-based Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a romanticized promotional showcase for Tom Ford's 'Fucking Fabulous' lipstick collection. It starts with a lifestyle-vlog style narrative about a boyfriend's romantic gift, then transitions into a high-quality product unboxing and professional-grade makeup application swatch series to encourage viewers to purchase the featured items.
